title: VHL with no I/O in the library
description: Engineering consequence of IHE VHL ITI-YY5, 2:3.YY5.4.2.4 Document Content Retrieval; Stakeholder directive: the library must carry the workshop user journeys.

statements.label: VHL with no I/O in the library
statements.requirement: The VHL functions SHALL do no network, file or clock access: the host sends the ITI-YY5 request and the ITI-68 document GETs over mutual TLS, holds the receiver's signing key, and logs AuditEvents. The library builds, parses, signs-by-proxy and decrypts.

sources.quote: Transport: Same ATNA secure channel used for ITI-YY5
